image: Wind moves across heaven: Small Store.
lines: Coming back by the same road —
Husband and wife glare at each other.
The wife carried on honoured virtue. Holding firm: danger.
For the noble one to march: misfortune.

notes.name_en: 小畜 is small keeping/restraining (畜 store, rear); paired with 26 Great Store. Not Wilhelm's 'Taming Power'.
notes.L6: 既雨既處 rain and rest both arrived; 尚德載婦 compressed, 婦 the wife kept.
